title: Simple QKD keyrate computations from tangent-line bounds
summary: Recent work in quantum key distribution (QKD) has yielded finite-size keyrates based on convex optimisation problems, using the framework of entropy accumulation. Multiple solvers have been developed to address these optimisations in recent years, but have been based on a somewhat elaborate framework using sophisticated algorithms, in order to accommodate a broad range of QKD protocols.
